## Assumptions

| open in the brief | assumption I took | why this one |
|---|---|---|
| tie-break "sort by category" — no direction given | ascending (A→Z) | "sort by X" with no direction reads as ascending; it's the stable, conventional reading |
| `n` larger than a month's entry count | return all entries of that month | `top n` conventionally means `min(n, available)`; dropping the month would be surprising |
| "unparseable amount must not count as 0" — how to handle it | raise `ValueError` | `parse_line` already raises on bad date / empty category; surfacing a bad number matches that pattern and directly satisfies "don't count as 0" (a silent skip would also hide a data error) |
| shape of `top`'s values ("รายการ n ตัว") | list of the full entry dicts, same shape `parse_line` returns | "items" most naturally means the entry records; reusing the parsed dicts is the minimal choice |
